text.en:
Port of Maco. The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of Maco situated
in the Municipality of Maco, Province of Compostela Valley, is hereby delineated and
established, particularly described as follows:
Beginning at a point marked 1 on the plan, being S. 41 deg. 21'58" W., 697.0671
m. from BLLM No. 12, Tagum Cadastre, thence:
N. 24 deg. 14'41" W., 238.85 m. to point 4;
46.85 m. to point of beginning,
Containing a total area of TWO HUNDRED FORTY THOUSAND FIVE
HUNDRED THIRTY-EIGHT SQUARE METERS AND SEVENTY-FOUR SQUARE
DECIMETERS (240,538.74), more or less.
@lice of the Breadent of the Philippines

PPA Jurisdiction. The Maco Port Zone, as delineated, is hereby
placed under the administrative jurisdiction of the PPA, which shall, consistent with the
regional industrial plans of the government, implement a program for the proper zoning,
planning, development and utilization of the port.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended
or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is declared
invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid
and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 4th
of December
Lord, Two Thousand and Twelve.
